title: gen-8 consumer scaffold: blackboard.py reads Phase B dispatch order with a printed fallback, consequence NOT yet attached
description: Build the consumer seam in .harness/bin/blackboard.py WITHOUT attaching any consequence yet (the consequence is chosen by docket C-002 / T-424 and attached in T-426). Deliverables: (1) a new test file .harness/tests/test_blackboard_next_ordering.py that FIRST pins the current contract of cmd_next/cmd_claim/cmd_status: order (priority asc, id asc), missing priority == 5, review->verifier only, engine 'any' passes, claim is first-come, plus a snapshot-hash zero-write assertion for next/status. The in-process fixture must redirect hc.HARNESS AND hc.BLACKBOARD/hc.STATE/hc.TASKS/hc.EVENTS/hc.GUARD (they are bound at import; reassigning HARNESS alone still hits the live root). (2) a helper in blackboard.py, e.g. phase_b_claim_order(candidates) -> (order_or_None, reason_line), that obtains recommended_claim_order by running reputation.py dispatch --json as a subprocess (sys.executable, --candidates csv); returns the order ONLY on returncode 0; on 1/4/any other or missing stdout returns None with a one-line reason built from dispatch's stderr line 2 ('<STATE> -- <detail>') or the exit code. It must never raise, never write, never import reputation's private functions, never pass --half-life-days. (3) a documented definition of 'live candidates' = identities holding an unexpired claim in blackboard.json plus the requesting --agent, deduplicated. (4) cmd_next and cmd_status print ONE advisory line 'phase-b claim order: a, b, c (VERIFIED, activation on)' when the order is available and 'phase-b claim order not applied: <reason>' otherwise; the existing sort and output lines stay byte-identical (pin that in tests). (5) tests for: gate closed (scratch root, no constitutional file) -> same task as today + reason line with the state token; gate open (fixture keypair enrolled + signed constitutional file, copy GateFixture from test_reputation_phase_b.py) -> advisory order equals dispatch --json for the same candidates; ties/unknown identities -> documented; dispatch exit 4 (corrupt precedent) and exit 1 -> no crash, today's order, reason printed. (6) run the full suite; test_reputation.py and test_reputation_phase_b.py must stay 41/32 passed untouched. Cite PR-061 (RAT-01) and PR-060 clause 6 in the helper docstring: no consequence binds here. Standing rules: claim with blackboard.py claim <ID> --agent <you>; lock every file you edit with lock.py acquire; no emojis; nothing tracked may contain user paths, sibling-project names or personal tooling; never sign anything; never touch .harness/keys, trust/, constitutional/; never route around prevent_data_loss.py; commit is done by the coordinator, not you; hand off with blackboard.py handoff <ID> --agent <you> --to-role verifier with replayable evidence (exact commands + expected output). A crash is not a refusal: fail closed with a named reason.
